_comment: The halvex dream campaign. `target` is the repo the dreams run against (cwd of each claude -p); override per-machine with `dream target PATH` (state) or DREAM_TARGET (env) — e.g. /srv/halvex/apps/data-pipeline on peppar. `scratch_dir`/`write_root` are relative to target: dreams write results into scratch_dir and the write-jail hook confines ALL writes to write_root. `env_file` (relative to target) is greped for DISCORD_DREAMS_WEBHOOK_URL. `accounts` is the strict alternation order for timer-driven runs; `dream loop --account X` overrides it. `default_interval_hours` seeds the mutable interval (`dream interval N`). `timeout_seconds` is a dream's ONLY hard stop (~3h; the prompt's effort guidance is a floor, not a deadline). `max_parallel` caps dreams in flight — dreams overlap by design (each is its own transient unit with MemoryMax=5G, so the cap is also the memory ceiling: cap x 5G).
